confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on sparse, mostly crowdsourced or undated listings for Sharm El Sheikh and nearby Egyptian resort towns (Hurghada, Dahab, New Cairo), and the searches returned no direct Sharm cocktail or wine-glass prices. Beer, coffee and meal anchors are bounded estimates with tourist-area uplift. Cocktail is set from the beer relationship, roughly 2.5 to 3 times beer, as a fallback. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no booking pages or current listings were inspected, and no accommodation search was run. Egyptian pound prices are sensitive to currency movements, so treat all anchors as indicative.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis is Egyptian Red Sea and Sinai resort-town pricing. Restaurant and drink anchors draw on Numbeo listings for Hurghada and Dahab, New Cairo, Expat Arrivals, and Trek Zone figures, adjusted upward for Sharm's tourist-area pricing. Cocktail uses the local beer relationship. Hostel and hotel anchors are model estimates, with Sharm's seasonal resort market and its limited hostel stock taken into account.
